Exact-model Fender Bassman 410/115 enclosure owner's manual; the specification table identifies Bassman 410 by model/part number 2347000000. It documents four 10-inch Eminence 8-ohm woofers, 96 dB sensitivity at 1 W/1 m, 8-ohm cabinet impedance, 350 W continuous power handling, and a separate 700 W program rating. Store only 350 W as continuous speaker power handling; the 700 W program figure is not substituted or collapsed into it. The manual describes a passive enclosure connected to a Bassman 250 head or another external bass amplifier, so active=false. It also mentions a fuse-protected horn, but does not state an unambiguous total driver count in the specification table; driverCount remains N/A. The official support archive calls this manual Bassman 115-410 (2005); 2005 is not assumed to be the model's release year. No frequency-response limit, response-point dataset, or directivity/polar dataset is published in the cited evidence. This non-Neo Bassman 410 is kept distinct from the separately documented Bassman 410 Neo.
